items.title: Appliance runtime contract exists
items.evidence: src/lib/runtime/appliance/appliance-runtime-contract.ts — tier (APPLIANCE_RUNTIME), hostAuthority, firstBootPhases (5), runtimeServices (5), honestCapabilities (6) vs roadmapCapabilities (3) cleanly separated.

items.title: ISO/OVA build process is real, reproducible, and documented
items.evidence: scripts/release/appliance/build-iso.sh (xorriso 8-step pipeline, autoinstall injection, GRUB rewrite) + scripts/release/vmware/build-ova.sh (qemu-img + OVF template + .mf SHA256 manifest, spec-compliant tar order). Documented in docs/architecture/VMWARE_DEPLOYMENT_AND_OPS.md.

items.title: VMware import actually works
items.evidence: OVA built with stream-optimized VMDK, vmx-21 spec, VMXNET3 NIC, .ovf first in tar archive, SHA256 manifest — all per VMware OVF 1.1 specification.

items.title: First boot sequence actually runs
items.evidence: scripts/release/iso/sita-first-boot.sh — 12-step provisioning (Docker wait → image load → secret generation → JWT signing → TLS cert → UFW/fail2ban → logrotate → networks → compose up → health checks → backup cron + OTA timer install).

items.title: Network setup works in appliance mode
items.evidence: scripts/release/iso/autoinstall/network-config covers VMware (ens160/ens192), KVM/Hyper-V (eth0), VirtIO (enp0s3) — all DHCP4 with DNS fallback (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8).

items.title: Persistence works after reboot
items.evidence: scripts/release/iso/sita-os.service — systemd unit with RemainAfterExit=yes + Restart=on-failure; Docker volumes preserved; /opt/sita persisted across reboots.

items.title: Update/OTA agent behavior is defined
items.evidence: scripts/release/iso/sita-ota-agent.sh — version check, image pull, compose up, 120s health check, automatic rollback on failure. sita-ota.timer triggers every 6h. sita-ota.service unit present.

items.title: Support diagnostics can be collected
items.evidence: scripts/release/iso/sita-metrics-agent.sh runs every 5min via sita-metrics.timer; reports hardware/health JSON. Backup script (sita-backup.sh) snapshots DB + Docker volumes + config with 30-day retention.

items.title: Startup services have defined order
items.evidence: generated/startup-order.json — 6 phases, 13 services with deterministic ordering. Systemd dependencies (After= / Wants=) declared in every unit file.

items.title: Appliance runtime capabilities are separated from Electron/web
items.evidence: src/lib/runtime/appliance/appliance-capabilities.ts (17 entries); src/lib/runtime/runtime-capability-matrix.ts has appliance column for every capability; src/lib/runtime/appliance/appliance-fallbacks.ts covers cross-runtime fallbacks.

items.title: Appliance claims are not ahead of implementation reality
items.evidence: appliance-runtime-contract.ts honestly lists bespoke-kernel, tpm-attestation, hardware-secure-enclave as roadmapCapabilities (NOT honestCapabilities). CI gate asserts no capability marked appliance:'native' is also in roadmapCapabilities. scripts/release/vmware/verify-esxi-readiness.ts emits generated/appliance-esxi-status.json — flips to 'ready' when ESXI_* + TPM_* env vars present in release CI. Provisioning runbook: docs/runbooks/APPLIANCE_ESXI_TPM_PROVISIONING.md.
items.remediation: Run docs/runbooks/APPLIANCE_ESXI_TPM_PROVISIONING.md to provision ESXi/vSphere lab + TPM 2.0 hardware; populate ESXI_* and TPM_* env vars; run verifier; once ready, move tpm-attestation from roadmapCapabilities to honestCapabilities.
